items.evidence: Vanilla 26.2 SpawnEggItem.getType reads the entity_data component's typed type() and spawns THAT type (javap-verified); the Rust derives the type from the item name only (trim_end_matches("_spawn_egg")) and spawn_egg_entity_data returns None when the data's id names a different type. Commands/op-only edge. Persists from 1.21.7 (same defect, different jar mechanism: TypedEntityData.type() in 26.2 vs CustomData.parseEntityType in 1.21.7).
items.title: Spawn egg entity_data id type override ignored

items.evidence: Vanilla 26.2 EntityType.spawn calls Mob.playAmbientSound() after addFreshEntityWithPassengers (javap-verified). The Rust's spawn_mob_spawned / use_spawn_egg play no sound; ambient sounds only come from the periodic Mob.baseTick timer later. Persists from 1.21.7.
items.title: No Mob.playAmbientSound() on spawn-egg placement

items.evidence: Vanilla 26.2 BoatItem.use returns PASS when the player's eye is inside a pickable entity's inflated bounding box (entities in the player bbox expanded 5.0 along the view + inflate 1.0; javap-verified). The Rust's boat_to_place only checks the boat's own bbox (unobstructed + boat_entity_collision, which checks the boat's bbox vs entities, not the eye). Edge case: standing inside a mob while placing a boat — the Rust places where vanilla passes. Persists from 1.21.7.
items.title: Boat placement missing the eye-inside-entity PASS check

items.evidence: Rust block_transform (game.rs:7895-7903) returns None when the offhand holds a blocks_attacks item and the player is not sneaking, for axe, hoe AND shovel. Vanilla's playerHasBlockingItemUseIntent is axe-only (javap-verified: present only in AxeItem; requires hand == MAIN_HAND + offhand has BLOCKS_ATTACKS + not secondary-use-active; no such check in HoeItem/ShovelItem). The Rust also does not check the acting hand is the main hand. Latent note in 1.21.7 (unobservable while the transformer was dead); observable in 26.2 now the transformer is live: a shield in the off hand blocks hoe tilling and shovel path-making/flattening where vanilla tills/flattens.
items.title: Shield blocking-intent check (axe-only in vanilla) also blocks hoe/shovel transforms, and ignores the acting hand

items.evidence: Rust use_block_transformer fires item_used_on_block (game.rs:7945) for ALL transforms, and use_campfire_douse fires it too (campfire_douse.rs:102). Vanilla 26.2 fires ITEM_USED_ON_BLOCK only in AxeItem.useOn (1 reference, javap-verified); HoeItem and ShovelItem have zero trigger references, and ItemStack.useOn does not fire it either (it only awards the ITEM_USED stat on Success). Hoe tilling, shovel flattening and shovel campfire dousing incorrectly trigger the advancement criterion in the port.
items.title: ITEM_USED_ON_BLOCK trigger fired for hoe till, shovel flatten and shovel campfire douse; vanilla fires it only for the axe

items.evidence: Rust transform_copper_chest_neighbour (game.rs:7980-8019) posts a BLOCK_CHANGE game event AND the scrape/wax-off level event (3004/3005) at the NEIGHBOUR half of a double copper chest. Vanilla 26.2 AxeItem.useOn sends the level event and BLOCK_CHANGE only at the clicked position (javap-verified). The neighbour particle + sculk-visible BLOCK_CHANGE is 26.3 BlockTransformer COPPER_CHEST behaviour (transform_type == "copper_chest", block_transform.rs:201,309,315) leaking into the 26.2 port.
items.title: Copper-chest scrape/wax-off posts a BLOCK_CHANGE + level event at the neighbour half (26.3 COPPER_CHEST behaviour)

items.evidence: Vanilla 26.2 ItemStack.use calls applyAfterUseComponentSideEffects for instant-use items (use duration <= 0) on Success, applying USE_REMAINDER and USE_COOLDOWN (javap-verified). items.json: ender_pearl 1.0s, wind_charge 0.5s. The port applies no cooldown on the throw path, implementing the opposite belief in four places (game/creatures.rs:7432, game/remote.rs:9327, game/using_item.rs:26: "26.2's ItemStack.use does not apply the use_cooldown component (26.3 added the side-effects call)" — the premise is wrong for 26.2; the side-effects call IS in 26.2's ItemStack.use). The cooldown gate itself exists but is never armed for pearls/wind charges, so they can be spammed. Chorus fruit is unaffected (timed consume; cooldown applies at finishUsingItem, which the port handles). No instant-use item has a use_remainder, so only the cooldown half bites.
items.title: Thrown ender pearls / wind charges start no use_cooldown; vanilla 26.2 applies it in ItemStack.use

systemic_note: The 26.2 story is the inverse of 1.21.7's. In 1.21.7, four majors shared one root cause: the port carried 26.x mechanisms for behaviours 1.21.7 implements in hardcoded Java, and the lookups silently degraded. In 26.2, the port authors already did the version-specific work: the block_transformer registry is correctly absent and replaced by hardcoded tables, the campfire douse / splash-water / teleport gates are implemented in 26.2's own (non-tag) form, and the bucket sneak check and spawn-egg peaceful gate — which ARE 26.2 behaviours — are implemented. The seven defects left are all small, local, and minor: three are 1.21.7 leftovers the 26.2 work did not touch (G03, G06, G12), and four are new 26.2 divergences where the port over- or under-applies a 26.2 rule (G13: axe-only check widened to hoe/shovel; G14: axe-only trigger widened to hoe/shovel; G15: a 26.3 chest behaviour carried into 26.2; G16: a wrong '26.2 ItemStack.use does not apply use_cooldown' belief baked into four comments). No whole item family is non-functional in 26.2.
